voice: ElevenLabs eleven_v4, Juanito (u1CVBnSUn9JiL8ssgd2v), Taglish, one take, split into lines, inner pauses capped at 0.32 s, no tempo change

lines.text: Bente-tres kami sa bus. Pero bente-kuwatro ang bilang ni kuya.
lines.beat_before: hook: down the aisle, the conductor counting with his punch; it stops on the seat behind me: her

lines.text: Huling biyahe pahilaga, alas-dose ng gabi. Tulog na halos lahat.
lines.beat_before: the bus on the mountain road at night, from above

lines.text: Sa isang liko sa tabi ng bangin, may pumara. Babae. Mag-isa, walang dala.
lines.beat_before: the curve by the ravine: a woman under the lamp; the bus slows, the door opens

lines.text: Umupo siya sa likod ko. Basang-basa ang buhok niya. Pero hindi umuulan.
lines.beat_before: she comes down the aisle in held-then-snapped steps, dripping, and sits behind me

lines.text: Lumapit si kuya para maningil. Pagtingin niya sa upuan... wala nang tao.
lines.beat_before: the conductor walks back to collect; the seat is empty

lines.text: Inihinto ng driver ang bus. Binilang kami isa-isa. Bente-tres.
lines.beat_before: the bus stopped, lights on: he counts everyone with his punch

lines.text: Pero yung sandalan sa likod ko, may lubog pa. At basa.
lines.beat_before: the empty seat: the headrest dented and wet, dripping

lines.text: Bumilang ulit si kuya. Pagdating sa akin, tumigil siya. Nakatingin siya sa likod ko.
lines.beat_before: his POV counting again; at me he stops: she is behind me
